typeWhisper.label: Open Source Project
typeWhisper.headline: Speech to text. Local. Cross-platform.
typeWhisper.intro: TypeWhisper is a free, open-source speech-to-text app that converts speech to text directly on your device - no cloud, no subscription. Available for macOS, Windows and iOS.

transcription.title: On-Device Transcription
transcription.description: Speech recognition runs entirely on-device using WhisperKit, Parakeet TDT and Apple Speech. No audio data leaves your device - maximum privacy with high recognition quality.

processing.title: AI Text Processing
processing.description: Transcribed text is optimized through LLM prompts. Per-app profiles automatically adjust formatting and style. A personal dictionary corrects technical terms and names.

integration.title: System Integration
integration.description: Global hotkey for instant access from any app. HTTP API and CLI for automation. Plugin system for Raycast and further integrations.
integration.tech: Global Hotkey, HTTP API, CLI, Plugins

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.item1: 100% local processing - no cloud dependency, full privacy
highlights.item2: Cross-platform for macOS, Windows and iOS
highlights.item3: Open source under GPLv3 license - free to use and extend

caseStudy.label: E-Commerce Project
caseStudy.headline: 11 years. One system. Built from scratch.
caseStudy.intro: From 2013 to 2024, I founded and led SeoFood - an e-commerce company with entirely self-developed infrastructure.

shop.title: Shop System
shop.description: Custom e-commerce platform with live preview for personalized engravings. Customers see exactly what they'll get in real-time – a configurator no standard shop could provide.

wms.title: WawiFood
wms.description: Custom warehouse management system for inventory control, stock management, and order processing with real-time synchronization to the shop.

automation.title: Engraving Automation
automation.description: Automatic control of laser and CNC engraving machines via PDF generation and printer drivers. Event-based system for real-time order processing.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.item1: Docker infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines on AWS
highlights.item2: Real-time event processing for immediate order handling
highlights.item3: Scalable architecture for growing order volume

valuemedia.description: E-commerce systems with Shopify, TypeScript frontend, REST APIs for order management.

homeAutomation.title: Smart Home & Home Automation
homeAutomation.description: Building a fully automated smart home with Home Assistant. Connecting sensors, actuators, and services into intelligent automations for lighting, heating, security, and energy management.
homeAutomation.tech: Home Assistant, MQTT, Zigbee, ESPHome, Node-RED

networking.title: Networking & Security
networking.description: Built complete home network with UniFi infrastructure. Segmentation with VLANs, separate networks for guests and IoT devices, firewall rules for maximum security.
